instruction: I want VLC to allow only a single instance when I open video files from my file manager. Can you enable the single instance mode for files in VLC?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's single instance mode when started from file (one-instance-when-started-from-file=1 in vlcrc config file). Similar difficulty to original task - both involve changing a single VLC preference setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly locates and retrieves VLC config file (vlcrc) based on OS platform
Metric (check_one_instance_when_started_from_file) correctly parses config file and checks for 'one-instance-when-started-from-file=' setting
Metric correctly defaults to '1' if setting not found, matching VLC's default behavior
Expected value (1) correctly represents enabled state for single instance mode
Postconfig appropriately kills and restarts VLC to ensure config is applied and persists
Evaluator provides complete coverage of instruction requirement: enabling single instance mode for files
State is accessible and persistent in VLC config file
